# Unramble

> Unramble is Kate Tyshchenko's evolving collection of interactive experiments, ideas, and a shared AI-powered vision board.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://unramble.me/): The index of eight interactive experiments and a collection of favorite quotes.
- [Vision Board](https://unramble.me/vision-board/): A public shared canvas for arranging words, photos, emojis, and AI-generated images. Viewing is public; editing is passcode-protected.
- [Sex Built This](https://unramble.me/taboo/): A fact-checked timeline of technology the porn and sex industries helped build, industrialize, stress-test, or improve.

## Interactive experiments

- [Somatic](https://unramble.me/somatic/): Short somatic care prompts for the nervous system.
- [Dandelions](https://unramble.me/dandelions/): A gentle interactive dandelion experience.
- [Seedrift](https://unramble.me/seedrift/): A breath-controlled seed experiment.
- [Applied Chaos](https://unramble.me/themes/): An interactive map of themes and connections.
- [Rorschach](https://unramble.me/rorschach/): An interactive inkblot experiment.
- [Restless](https://unramble.me/restless/): A generative visual experiment.
